subject: Tranche delivery cadence: OEM queue and cloud fall-through alignment
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc:
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Tranche delivery cadence: OEM queue and cloud fall-through alignment

Hi team,

Orbit has firmed up their Q4 onboarding window in the sales deck: they want a 3-tranche onramp (50% -> 30% -> 20%) starting mid-November, with production samples in week 1 of each tranche. They requested firm start dates for each tranche for their internal compliance sign-off.

Current constraints we need to reconcile before we promise dates:
- ChipCo (OEM) queue shows a Q4 slot but it's not contiguous; lead times are quoted as 8-12 weeks per tranche.
- CloudA has offered burst capacity but only at a reduced SLA and a higher effective $/token for sustained traffic.

Ask: can you pull the latest OEM ETA and vendor cadence, and propose a concrete phased commitment we can give Orbit by EOD Friday? If we can't guarantee the full Q4 onramp on OEM hardware, we need a clear mutually agreed fall-through plan using CloudA (including pricing and SLA tradeoffs) so sales can include that in the MAP and procurement docs.

Attached: Orbit_demand_forecast.csv (rough weekly committed token-hours by tranche).

Sofia
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Orbit_demand_forecast.csv (CSV)]

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tranche delivery cadence: OEM queue and cloud fall-through alignment

Sofia / Karthik —

Quick update after syncing with ChipCo and CloudA:

1) ChipCo (sales) returned a formal ETA: they can allocate 60% of the requested capacity into a contiguous Q4 tranche (target ship week starting Nov 22) and the remaining 40% would be staged into their Q1 build (ship window late Jan). They attached their ETA letter.

2) CloudA confirmed they can provide immediate burst capacity for the initial weeks, but their guaranteed throughput for reserved instances requires a 6-week lead to provision. Pricing for burst/short-term usage is ~2.3x our standard hosted unit rate; longer reserves (30-90 days) can be negotiated lower. They included a short note on commitment levels.

Recommendation: offer Orbit a split plan — commit to a first OEM tranche of ~60% as firm Q4 start, cover the early ramp with CloudA bursts during the first 2-3 weeks while OEM init completes, then backfill remaining 40% with either staged OEM shipments (Q1) or a paid CloudA reserve if Orbit wants everything within Q4.

Open items for legal/procurement: carveouts for OEM-delivered SLA vs CloudA SLA; an amendment template for tranche phasing; pricing for hybrid mix.

Attachments: ChipCo_ETA_Q4.pdf, CloudA_shortfall_commitments.txt

—Ben
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ChipCo_ETA_Q4.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: CloudA_shortfall_commitments.txt (TXT)]

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@orbit-sys.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 08:30:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Tranche delivery cadence: OEM queue and cloud fall-through alignment

Sofia / Ben —

Thanks for the fast work here. Orbit's procurement committee needs at least firm start dates for the first two tranches (not just a percent split) to complete our compliance and data residency sign-off. If the first tranche can't start in the Nov 22 window, we will need an explicit CloudA fall-through plan with guaranteed burst pricing and an upper bound on latency for the first 30 days.

We prefer OEM hardware for production but can accept a hybrid model if the fall-through is codified in the SOW. Also — we cannot accept a scenario where the second tranche is pushed into Q1 without a documented escalation path (credits, rollback plan).

Appreciate the detail in Ben's note. Please confirm concrete dates and the SLA/pricing tradeoffs by EOD Friday so we can proceed with the PO.

—Liam
Director, Cloud Ops
Orbit Systems

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Final: tranche phasing proposal and action items for Orbit SOW

Team —

Per the threads and Orbit's ask, here's a concrete plan we can present and start routing for approvals:

1) Phase 1 (Nov 22 start): OEM-backed tranche covering 60% of committed units. Target start date: 2026-11-22 (OEM ship and rack by 11/20, infra QA 11/22-11/25).
2) Phase 1 fall-through: CloudA burst committed for week 1-3 (2026-11-22 -> 2026-12-12). CloudA pricing for burst: 2.3x hosted rate; if Orbit converts burst to a 30-day reserve within that window, we negotiate to 1.5x.
3) Phase 2: we hold a conditional slot for the next 30% in OEM Q1 (target ship week Jan 24) OR convert to CloudA 60-day reserve if Orbit requests Q4 completion for an uplift.
4) Phase 3: final 10% to be planned as a Q1 drop-in (buffer).

Action items / owners:
- Ben: confirm ChipCo formal ETA language and a written commitment to the Nov 20 ship milestone (due Thu EOD).
- Sofia: confirm Orbit will accept the split and the CloudA fall-through economics (SOW slide) by Fri EOD.
- Rishi: engage Legal for amendment template and credits/rollback language; loop Procurement on vendor carveouts.

I'll prepare a single-slide MAP and the SOW amendment draft. HubSpot link and DocuSign envelope below — once Orbit signs the amendment we can lock the reserve.
